title: 🏛️ Exams 2023–2025 · the cleanest, the coldest — and the people who help ⭐⭐

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2024 — language, exercise 1)
Every weekend, the people of a neighbourhood organize a clean-up day. Pick the verb that goes in the blank: "We ___ rubbish and put it in the bins."
questions.explanation: The rubbish is put in the bins after somebody gathers it from the street, and gathering things is called collecting. You tidy up a room, you paint a wall and you water plants, and none of the three describes picking up rubbish.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2024 — language, exercise 1)
Every weekend the people clean their neighbourhood, so it beats all the other neighbourhoods of the city. Fill in the gap: "Our neighbourhood is the ___ one in the city."
questions.explanation: One neighbourhood above all the others of the city calls for the superlative: the + clean + est = the cleanest. The form cleaner compares only two places, the plain adjective clean says nothing about the other neighbourhoods, and cleaning names an action and not a quality.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023 — language, exercise 3)
A text says: "There are four seasons in the year. Summer is the hottest one." Complete with the opposite: "Winter is the ___ one."
questions.explanation: The opposite of hottest is coldest: winter is above all the other seasons in cold, so the superlative of cold takes the and -est. The form colder compares only two seasons, hottest repeats the word you are given, and the plain adjective cold cannot say that winter beats all the others.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2024 — language, exercise 3)
Peter is a student, and in summer he works in a big restaurant. Put the word in brackets in the right form: "He works as a [wait] ___ ."
questions.explanation: The person who does the action is the verb plus -er: wait + er = a waiter, and the person in the question is a he. The form waiting names the activity, waits is the he form of the verb, and waitress names a woman.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025 — language, exercise 2)
Put the word in brackets in the right form: "She makes delicious meals every day. She is a good [cook] ___ ."
questions.explanation: The person who cooks is called a cook: this job name is learnt as it is and takes no ending. A cooker is the machine in the kitchen and not the person, cooking names the activity, and cooks is the she form of the verb.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025 — language, exercise 1)
Children's Day is a day when other people show love to every child and look after him or her. Which form of the word belongs in the blank? "On that day every child is loved and ___ for."
questions.explanation: The blank goes with loved: the child is loved and looked after by others, which is said with the -ed form, loved and cared for. The forms caring and care do not make a word that goes with loved in front of for, and cares is the he form of the verb.
